review.notes: No code fences in the OCR source; the Acknowledgements paragraph on physical p.9 is present and complete. Word-level diff of extracted text from all 9 physical pages against the OCR markdown found no other dropped prose, tables (Table 1 values match the print) or reference entries; remaining diff lines are LaTeX tokenization artifacts, the arXiv margin stamp and figure captions present around their image embeds. Pages 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 9 rendered and inspected; page 5 equations (3)-(4) and the Extras bullet re-read at 220 dpi. The printed 'Enlish', 'Roberb Lasenby', 'Portugese', '(lla, 2024)' and 'Llama Guard 3-8B(Llama Team, 2024a)' spellings are the print's own and were preserved or restored.
